questions.q: What did Hezekiah do when he heard what the Assyrian official had said?
questions.a: Hezekiah tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Yahweh. He also sent Eliakim, Shebna, and the elders of the priests to Isaiah the prophet.

questions.q: How did Hezekiah describe the situation in Jerusalem?
questions.a: Hezekiah said it was a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace, like a woman who is about to give birth but does not have the strength to do so.

questions.q: What did Hezekiah ask Isaiah to do?
questions.a: He asked Isaiah to pray to Yahweh for the remaining remnant.

questions.q: What message did Isaiah give to Hezekiah’s servants to take back to Hezekiah?
questions.a: Isaiah told them that Yahweh said not to fear the words that the servants of the king of Assyria had spoken against him. Yahweh was going to put a spirit in the king of Assyria so that he would hear a report, return to his own land, and fall there by the sword.

questions.q: After the king of Assyria heard that Tirhakah, king of Cush, was coming out to fight against him, what message did the king of Assyria send to Hezekiah?
questions.a: The king of Assyria told Hezekiah not to let his God deceive him by saying that Jerusalem would not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

questions.q: Did the gods of the destroyed nations deliver them?
questions.a: No, the gods of the other natins did not rescue them.

questions.q: What did Hezekiah do after he received the letter from the king of Assyria and read it?
questions.a: Hezekiah went up to the house of Yahweh, spread the letter out before Yahweh, and prayed to him.

questions.q: How did Hezekiah describe Yahweh in his prayer?
questions.a: Hezekiah said that Yahweh alone is God over all the kingdoms of the earth and that Yahweh made the heavens and the earth.

questions.q: What did Hezekiah ask Yahweh to do regarding Sennacherib’s words?
questions.a: Hezekiah asked Yahweh to listen, to open his eyes and see, and to hear all the words Sennacherib had sent to mock the living God.

questions.q: Of what are the gods of the nations made?
questions.a: They are made of wood and stone, the work of the hands of man.

questions.q: What did Hezekiah ask Yahweh to do for them?
questions.a: Hezekiah asked Yahweh to save them from the hand of the king of Assyria.

questions.q: What reason did Hezekiah give as motivation for God to save them?
questions.a: Hezekiah wanted Yahweh to save them so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that Yahweh alone is God.

questions.q: How did Yahweh respond to Hezekiah’s prayer?
questions.a: Yahweh responded by sending a message to Hezekiah through Isaiah.

questions.q: How did Yahweh describe the reaction of the daughter of Zion to Sennacherib?
questions.a: Yahweh said that the virgin daughter of Zion despised and scorned Sennacherib, and that the daughter of Jerusalem shook her head at him.

questions.q: In Yahweh’s message to Hezekiah, what did Yahweh say Sennacherib had done wrong?
questions.a: Yahweh said that Sennacherib had defied and insulted him, exalted his voice, and lifted up his eyes against the Holy One of Israel.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say he had determined long ago?
questions.a: Yahweh determined long ago that Sennacherib would devastate fortressed cities into heaps of ruins.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say he knew about Sennacherib?
questions.a: Yahweh said he knew when Sennacherib sat down, went out, and came in, and that Sennacherib was raging against him.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say he would do because of Sennacherib’s raging against him?
questions.a: Yahweh said he would put his hook in Sennacherib’s nose and his bit in his mouth and turn him back by the way he came.

questions.q: What will become of the survivors of the house of Judah?
questions.a: They will add a root downward and make fruit upward.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say about the king of Assyria concerning Jerusalem?
questions.a: Yahweh said the king of Assyria would not enter Jerusalem or shoot an arrow there, and that he would not approach it with a shield or build siegeworks against it.

questions.q: What reason did Yahweh give for defending and saving Jerusalem?
questions.a: Yahweh said he would defend and save Jerusalem for his own sake and for the sake of David his servant.

questions.q: What did the angel of Yahweh do?
questions.a: The angel of Yahweh went out and struck 185,000 in the camp of Assyria.

questions.q: What happened to Sennacherib after he departed and went home to Nineveh?
questions.a: While he was worshiping in the house of Nisrok his god, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer struck him with the sword.

commentary.text: This chapter is the same as II Kin. 19.
